metadata.axis: x east, y up from campus datum, z south
metadata.transformation: EPSG:25832 to WGS84 with PROJ, then local equirectangular matching campus.json. y = original NHN height minus minimum of 11 building base heights.
metadata.precisionNote: Serialized millimetres do not imply millimetre accuracy. LoD2 models use standard roof forms; not a facade or interior survey.
uncertainties: No surveyed room geometry, storey elevations, windows, doors or facade detail.
Individual building footprint currency and model creation dates differ; snapshot retrieval is not a survey date.
Terrain between buildings is not included; baseY preserves original inter-building elevation differences.
Ground polygon surfaces can consist of several polygons for one building; do not assume a single rectangle.
